card.name: Introducing a single example or tip
card.fires_on: Words right after a singular item that is about to be introduced, such as 'one type', 'one practical activity', 'a little trick' or 'the following technique'. It fires on the next small word (of, for, to, is, can) or on 'one' after 'discuss/describes'.

modes.label: After 'one' or 'one type'
modes.description: The word 'one' or 'of' when an article says it will present a single example.
modes.example: We'll discuss<< one>> type of solid state transducer here

modes.label: After 'the following' + noun
modes.description: The linking verb or modal after 'the following suggestion/technique/activity' that introduces a statement.
modes.example: the following technique<< can>> be recommended: If regional anesthesia was not

modes.label: Tip introduced with a noun
modes.description: The word after a noun like 'trick' or 'activity' that leads into what it is used for.
modes.example: Here’s a little trick you can use<< to>> remember how long to scrub

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated and mixed.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to introduce one specific example, tip or method.
